old: Would you believe that this ridiculous man had been in love
new: Would you believe that the crazy fellow had been in love
reason: Source: 'Would you believe that the crazy fellow had conceived a passion for Dounia'. The fidelity edit later in this paragraph restored 'treating the crazy fellow too harshly' on the grounds that it echoes her earlier phrase, but the earlier phrase still reads 'this ridiculous man', so the echo is missing. 'Ridiculous' also shifts her pitying 'crazy' toward scorn.
Source: 'and stood up in terror'. The fix from 'sat up' was right, but 'jumped up' adds an abruptness the source does not have. Use the source verb.
The landlady is named here for the first time, so a listener has no way to know who Praskovya Pavlovna is.
